name: Patchwerk
guide_text: You can afford to stabilize on higher tavern tiers because of your extra HP.
buddy_guide_text: Powerlevel to 4 by turn 5 and try to hit an early rally value generator, such as [[Bigwig Bandit||122179]] or [[Friendly Bouncer]]. Then, buffing this rally card with your buddy every turn will make it attack an insane amount of times and snowball out of control.
